items.text: Create your own theme, step by step, with the "＋ Create a theme" button next to the theme menu.
Add your own background picture (JPG, PNG, WebP or an animated GIF, up to 8 MB). Darken and blur it so the text stays easy to read.
Share a theme with everyone or keep it private. You can edit or delete your themes any time.
"Reduce motion" (in the Panels menu) keeps animated backgrounds still.
A theme can come with a mini-player version, picture included. You need the updated app (0.5.0) to see it.
After the app updates, What's new opens by itself. You can also open it any time from the ☰ menu in the mini-player.
Playlists now show real songs, with artwork, artist and length. Your old playlists were upgraded for you automatically.
Add to playlist is now on the song that's playing, the queue, History, Most played and search results.
Drag songs to put them in a different order.
Removed a song by mistake? Press Undo to put it back.
A song that couldn't load now has a Retry button.
Paste a YouTube, Spotify or SoundCloud playlist or album link to turn it into a playlist.
Deleted playlists wait in a Deleted folder for 7 days, so you can restore one if you change your mind.
Friends can edit the same playlist at the same time.
Start a playlist from any song you pick, not just the first one.
The mini-player has an add-to-playlist button too, and shows the real number of songs in each playlist.
In Discord, play a playlist with "play playlist Name", or "play playlist Folder/Name" for one inside a folder. Editing playlists now happens in the panel instead.
Drag the panel's panes around to rearrange them in the app, just like in the browser.
Drop audio files onto the app to upload them.

notes.title: Autoplay, skip non-music and a bigger mini-player

items.text: Autoplay keeps the music going with related songs when the queue runs out. Turn it on with the Autoplay button, or type autoplay in Discord.
Skip non-music jumps over intros and talking in YouTube videos (SponsorBlock). It's on by default; turn it off with the Skip non-music button or the sponsorblock command in Discord.
Up Next shows what's queued, right in the mini-player.
Shuffle and repeat buttons are now in the mini-player.
Drag the progress bar to jump to any spot in a song.
Recent, Most played and Playlists tabs make it quick to find something to play.
A sleep timer pauses the music after 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or at the end of the current song.
The mini-player hides itself while a fullscreen game is running on its monitor.
Optional hotkeys let you control the music from any app. They're off until you switch them on in the menu.
Compact mode makes the mini-player smaller.
